title: Chainstalker
tagline: Chainstalker - is a plugin that unveils onchain reputation (data) of other users / wallets while you browsing your socials, news, art or gaming platforms.
description:
Chainstalker is a browser plugin that recognizes on-chain credentials as ENS or Lens profile published on users' bio in web2 socials, "googling" the on-chain activity of those users and gathers it into a human-readable widget for you to unveil users' on-chain reputation on the run.  

With Chain Stalker, you can learn more about people you mean in virtual worlds.
1. How long are they in the space
2. Which community do they belong to 
3. The latest geo check-in via POAP 
4. ID credentials

And much more other valuable info :)

It works as with ENS, Lens, and with 0x addressed on the web.

Try it, and you will feel you have more info than before.

how_its_made:
This project is a synergy of Zerion and 1inch APIs. We are using Zerion API for information about avatar, balance. We are using 1inch API for transactions scoring (last 7 days, age) 

We are using lens to check info about domains as well as ENS.

We do have a deep integration of POAP API.

We are indexing data across 6+ EVM chains like Eth, Binance, Gnosis, Polygon and Arbitrum with Avalanche

We search if the user has a verified World Coin profile, an alternative to a verification badge on popular social networks. 

The notable Part
We search for the most recent poaps of the user, recognize it and define the user's latest location by the poap it was claimed by.
